result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signals but lacks physical protection for pedestrians crossing a wide multi-lane roadway. The presence of a gas station and wide corner radii suggests a vehicle-oriented environment with significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The corner design allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the gas station entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the effective crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features multi-lane roadways with significant crossing distances, creating high exposure for pedestrians. While basic infrastructure like marked crosswalks and signals are present, the overall design prioritizes high-volume vehicle throughput over pedestrian comfort and safety.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing their time of exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: High-Speed Road Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and multiple through-lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing the potential severity of collisions.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Enhanced Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Widen and harden the existing median refuge to provide a safer waiting area for pedestrians who cannot complete the crossing in one cycle.

result.summary: This wide, multi-lane commercial intersection features long crossing distances and minimal pedestrian-specific infrastructure. While a marked crosswalk is visible, the lack of pedestrian signals and the scale of the roadway prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the image

hazards.name: Faded pavement markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk and lane markings are worn and faded, reducing their visibility to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: On the roadway surface at the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Median refuge island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. The wide roadway and multiple lanes create a long crossing distance, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic in a commercial setting.
